items.name: Manchester Cubing League - Second 2026
items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

Welcome to the first ever cubing league in Manchester! Top 16 finishers from each finals will be awarded points. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManchesterCLSecond2026#67476-manchester-cubing-league).

**Please note this competition takes place on a Bank Holiday Monday.**
**Only first 16 registered for 4BLD/5BLD can compete in 4BLD/5BLD.**
